fact: The Ministry of Justice and Human Rights said on 21 July 2026 that the e-Justice platform, developed by Malian teams, is about to launch, first for online nationality certificates and criminal records, with a second phase extending it to digital management of judicial files.
UNDP, with Dutch support, handed Mali's Ministry of Justice laptops, tablets and modems worth USD 493,193 on 5 November 2026 to equip the operationalisation of its e-justice platform.

Justice Minister Mamoudou Kassogue said on 5 November 2026 that the ministry is operationalising a national e-justice platform whose first services are digital criminal-record extracts and nationality certificates, with later features to cover case processing.
